verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a plausible feature for a SaaS file-conversion service, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a manual web uploader, format-specific converters and a REST API, with no assistant or agent that users can delegate tasks to. Conversions like MP3 to Text are format transforms, not an AI assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
